questions.prompt: 按第一条件句的if从句“一般现在时”形式选择：If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.explanation: 题目明确要求if从句采用一般现在时，it为第三人称单数，因此选rains。is raining也可以出现在谈未来的条件句中，但它是现在进行时，不是本题指定的形式；不能笼统说它在所有条件句里都错误。
questions.evidence: If the school gets more money, it will also buy more books for the reading buddy plan.

questions.prompt: If I ______ more free time, I would join the reading club.
questions.explanation: 主句would join把情境设为现在或未来的假设，if从句用过去式had。此句是独立语法例句，不是声称源文人物缺少空闲时间。
questions.evidence: If I had more free time, I would join the reading club.

questions.prompt: There are ______ students in the small group, but only ______ time for questions.
questions.explanation: students 是可数名词复数，用 many；time 是不可数名词，用 little。因此选 many; little。
questions.evidence: Each extra teacher worked with groups of six students for 30 minutes, four times a week.

questions.prompt: The school bought 60 new reading books. ______ were shared among all the groups.
questions.explanation: 前文提到 60 new reading books 是复数，指代它们用 They。
questions.evidence: The school also bought 60 new reading books and 20 maths workbooks. These resources were shared among all the groups.

questions.prompt: 用表示结果“因此”的连接词：The printer is broken. ______, we will send the worksheets by email.
questions.explanation: 这是独立的新语境例句。题目指定用“因此”表达前因后果，Therefore符合；However和In contrast表转折，For example引出例子，都不表达题目要求的结果关系。
questions.evidence: The printer is broken. Therefore, we will send the worksheets by email.

questions.prompt: If the teachers ______ more help, the students would learn faster.
questions.explanation: 这是想象获得更多帮助后的情形：主句用would learn，if从句用过去式got。它表达假设，并不要求先证明现实一定相反。
questions.evidence: If the teachers got more help, the students would learn faster.

questions.prompt: We have ______ money this year, so we can only buy ______ books.
questions.explanation: money 不可数，用 little；books 可数复数，用 a few。因此选 little; a few。
questions.evidence: The school had a limited budget, so the head teacher, Ms. Chen, had to decide how to use the money and the teachers' time.

questions.prompt: The reading buddy plan used old books. ______, it did not cost much money.
questions.explanation: 前后是结果关系：因为使用旧书，所以花费不多。As a result 表示“结果”。
questions.evidence: The school did not buy any new materials for this plan; it used the books it already had.

title: A Review of the Bridge Program: How One School Shared Its Resources · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
本课重点有三：1）条件句：表示“如果……就……”。真实可能发生用“if + 一般现在时，主句用 will/can + 动词原形”，例如“If the school gets more money, it will buy more books.”；谈现在或未来的想象、较不可能的情况，或与现实相反的情况，用“if + 过去式，主句用 would/could + 动词原形”，例如“If I had more time, I would join the group.”。2）数量词：可数名词用 many/few/a few，不可数名词用 much/little/a little；a lot of 两者皆可。3）段落间的指代与衔接：用 this/these/that/it/they 指代前文内容，用 however/therefore/also/first/second 等连接词使段落连贯。注意：本课新学“if 条件句（真实与虚拟）”，复习“数量词”和“指代衔接”。

If the school gets more money, it will also buy more books for the reading buddy plan.
